RelatedWorksPlanPage.title: Published research outputs
RelatedWorksPlanPage.description: Enrich your plans by linking them to published research outputs, such as datasets, software and papers. Linking makes your outputs easier to find, adds them to your DMP-ID's metadata, and shows you met funder sharing requirements. For published plans, we'll find outputs that may match — just review and Confirm matches. You can also add your own using a DOI.

ACCEPTED.description: When you confirm a match or add a research output using its DOI, it will be listed here and linked to your plan's DMP-ID.

PENDING.description: We regularly search public scholarly sources for research outputs that may relate to your published plans. New matches will appear here for you to confirm.

REJECTED.description: Matches you dismiss are kept here, so you can restore them for review or confirm them later if you change your mind.

AddRelatedWorkProjectPage.description: Each published research output is linked to one plan in this project. Choose the plan this output belongs to, then add it using its DOI.

AddRelatedWorkPlanPage.title: Add Published Research Output
AddRelatedWorkPlanPage.description: To manually add a published research output to a plan, enter output's DOI below and click Lookup to find it. Click Accept to add the output to the plan. You can run multiple searches on this page to add more than one output.

RelatedWorksAdd.title: Add Published Research Output
RelatedWorksAdd.searchDescription: Enter the output's DOI in either short or URL form (e.g. 10.1000/182 or https://doi.org/10.1000/182), then click Lookup.

RelatedWorksAddPanel.title: Add your own research output
RelatedWorksAddPanel.descriptionPublished: Know of a published dataset, article or piece of software we haven't found? Add it to one of your plans using its DOI.
RelatedWorksAddPanel.descriptionUnpublished: Add a published dataset, article or piece of software to one of your plans using its DOI.

RelatedWorksUnpublished.title: Publish your plan to find research outputs
RelatedWorksUnpublished.intro: You need to publish your plan before we can find published research outputs that may relate to it. In the meantime, you can add your own. Once it's published:

steps.search: We search public scholarly sources for published research outputs — datasets, software and papers — that may relate to your plan.
steps.review: You review the matches we find and confirm the ones that belong.
steps.linked: Confirmed outputs are linked to your plan and its DMP-ID. You can also add your own at any time using a DOI.
